summary.value: Night Hotel Broadway is a simple, quirky budget Hotel on the Upper West Side, New York City whose biggest asset is a quick walk to the 96th Street subway. Guests warm to its unusual style and like the renovated rooms, but older parts of the hotel feel tired.

claims.text: Hotel on the Upper West Side, New York City

description.value: Night Hotel Broadway is a Hotel on the Upper West Side, New York City, on Broadway with Riverside Park and Central Park nearby. Trip.com shows 6.7 / 10 64 reviews. Guests say The location is outstanding, just 2-3 minutes from 96th Street and appreciate that the staff cleans and makes the beds every day. Renovated rooms in quiet positions earn the best feedback; the watch-out is that the hotel is somewhat out dated elsewhere, so choose an updated room category.

itineraryNote: Night Hotel Broadway: a budget Upper West Side stay just 2-3 minutes from 96th Street; ask for a renovated room and use it as a subway launchpad.
review1: Night Hotel Broadway's Upper West Side location near the 96th Street station is its strongest selling point, making subway trips quick and simple.
review2: Guests describe the hotel's unusual design as surprising at first, but most say it becomes comfortable and enjoyable once they settle in.
review3: Renovated rooms in quieter positions get the best reviews, with guests describing restful nights after choosing an updated room category.
review4: The recurring watch-out is that parts of the hotel feel dated, so it pays to book a renovated room rather than the most basic option.
